purpose: Visual concept, retained for a future homepage redesign by owner request
reference: Screenshot of the About page at cli-docs commit f1ee709dc3992f1c27f2cafac3339efca504ee51
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity desktop About page concept for WireCat, as a visual proposal, not a deployed UI. The reference image is the incumbent brand and the layout to improve. Preserve the purple circular WireCat logo, green-tinted off-white ground #f1f4f2, dark green ink #182822, purple accent #4b53f0, rounded geometric Unbounded headings and clean Onest body. Retain compact top navigation and a discreet footer. About explains an open-source product, not a sales service page. Exact product truth: open-source Telegram and MAX command-line tools, search conversations, review source messages, connect the AI agent of your choice, MIT licence. Custom AI workflows and integrations are only a small funding note near the bottom. No customer logos, invented numbers, pricing or sales CTA. Make the first viewport dense enough to be interesting, with meaningful sample content, smaller padding, no giant mostly empty hero panel. Use comfortably sized headings around 40-48px, lively composition and genuine product evidence rather than random decoration. Show a complete page at a landscape desktop viewport, readable enough to assess hierarchy, with later sections visible. Label all example messages SAMPLE DATA. Sample facts: Atlas invoice deadline confirmed Friday October 9; Tuesday was an earlier rejected proposal. Include a clear Try the demo link and documentation link. Structure: GUIDED TASK. A compact left column explains WireCat and asks What did we agree with the client? A richly composed visual task sequence occupies the first viewport: sample question, two source message excerpts and a concise confirmed decision, connected by fine purposeful purple lines with numbered stages. Continue the same narrative into Search, Check the sources, Work with your agent. Include Telegram/MAX tool links and a small Open source / Your data / Your agent band. This should feel like a hands-on field guide, energetic and clear.
